header: IN THE HIGH COURT OF SINDH,
DATE ORDER WITH SIGNATURE OF JUDGE
None present for the appellant nor any intimation is received. Even on
body: the last date of hearing the appellant was present; however, his counsel was absent, which reflects that counsel for the appellant has lost interest in pursuing the matter. Therefore, this Court has no option but to dismiss the instant Criminal Acquittal Appeal for non-prosecution. Accordingly, it stands dismissed for non-prosecution.
